title: Omdia: OLED Display Shipments Featuring Active Privacy View to Reach 91.7 Million Units by 2033
summary: LONDON, November 26, 2026--Shipments of OLED displays featuring Active Privacy View (APV) are forecast to reach 91.7 million units by 2033, accounting for approximately 6.6% of total OLED display shipments, according to new research from Omdia.

title: Omdia: 65-Inch LCD TV Panel Cost to Rise 6.5% in 4Q26 Amid Higher PCB Prices
summary: LONDON, November 24, 2026--The cost of producing a 65-inch 4K TFT LCD panel is expected to rise 6.5% year-on-year (YoY) in the fourth quarter of 2026, according to Omdia. Investment in AI servers has tightened the market for printed circuit boards (PCBs), driving up prices for a key panel component.

title: Omdia: Africa's Smartphone Shipments Fall 40% in 3Q26, With a Further 25% Decline Forecast for 2027
summary: LONDON, November 23, 2026--Smartphone shipments in Africa fell 40% year-on-year (YoY) to 13.7 million units, down from 22.8 million a year earlier, according to Omdia’s latest research. This marked the steepest YoY decline in three years following three consecutive years of third-quarter growth. Rising component costs and currency pressures are changing how vendors price their devices and how consumers buy them across Africa's largest markets.

title: Omdia: Netflix Beats YouTube in Daily Viewing Time Across Four Latin American Markets
summary: LONDON, November 17, 2026--Viewers spend significantly more time watching Netflix than YouTube, across four major Latin American markets, according to new Omdia analysis of Digital i data presented at MIP Cancun.

title: Omdia: Middle East Smartphone Shipments Fall 29% in 3Q26, Marking the Sharpest Decline in Two Years
summary: LONDON, November 17, 2026--Smartphone shipments in the Middle East (excluding Turkey) fell 29% year-on-year (YoY) to 10.7 million units in 3Q26, according to Omdia’s latest research. Rising component costs, limited availability of entry-level devices and weaker retail demand drove the decline. Seasonal softness during summer travel, geopolitical uncertainty and cautious channel replenishment added further pressure. title: Omdia: Southeast Asia Smartphone Shipments Fall 36% in 3Q26 as Memory Supply Constraints Intensify
summary: LONDON, November 16, 2026--According to the latest research from Omdia, Southeast Asia's smartphone market declined 36% year-on-year (YoY) in 3Q26, with shipments falling to 16.5 million units. This contraction continues a trend seen in the first half of 2026, as memory supply shortages and rising component costs constrained vendor shipments.
